On the road of their elopement, she was personally captured and brought back to the capital by her cousin, Xie Ling.
Xie Ling, the eldest legitimate grandson of a noble family, strictly adhered to etiquette and teachings, and was also rigid and pedantic. In his eyes, she was flirtatious, frivolous, and wanton, the type of woman that he, aloof as snow on a high peak, most despised. After she was captured and brought back to the capital, he subjected her to the family law.
Thus, the first thing Ruan Ningyu did after becoming the Empress was to haphazardly play matchmaker, using her imperial power to forcibly grant him a wife. Xie Ling’s wife was well-educated and polite, a noble lady from a prominent family, and they shared a deep marital affection.
Later, she sent a maidservant to plead with Chief Minister Xie, who by then held immense power over the court, proposing an exchange of benefits to spare her life. The man was silent for a long while, then instructed his subordinates.
“My wife prefers quiet and must not be startled. If any irrelevant people disturb my wife’s peace again in the future, you will be held accountable.”
Compared to his wife, who was respected by the common people, she was merely the Empress who brought disaster to the country and calamity to the people, deserving ten thousand deaths. She thought, she had probably never once truly caught his attention.
Reborn back to the time when she was young, Ruan Ningyu only wanted to stay far, far away from this powerful minister cousin of hers and not repeat her past mistakes. On her way to escape the Xie Mansion, Young Marquis Shen, whom she had toyed with and then abandoned in her previous life, relentlessly pursued her. The seemingly pitiful Seventh Prince, whom she had nurtured, was actually dark-hearted and scheming to possess her…
Little did she imagine that one day she would actually pluck Xie Ling, this “flower from a high peak,” watching him grovel and plead before her, gradually going mad.

117751.synopsis:
After transmigrating to a different world, Shen Yuan accidentally fished up a mysterious turtle shell from a river and activated the [Daily Divination] system, which was bound to his family.
[Today’s Divination · Auspicious] :
You will pass by Blackwater Pond and unexpectedly encounter a century-old Blood Toad shedding its skin. The shed skin has high medicinal value and can be sold for 200 taels of silver.
[Today’s Divination · Great Misfortune] :
A barbarian scout squad has infiltrated Hidden Dragon Mountain. If you go into the mountains to chop wood, you will suffer a bloody calamity.
[Today’s Divination · Auspicious] :
You will take your son hunting in Hidden Dragon Mountain and encounter a fortunate opportunity.
[Today’s Divination · Great Fortune] :
You will spend a large sum to buy a plot of mountain land from the county office. Hidden beneath it is a low-grade spirit stone vein.
…
With the guidance of the divinations, Shen Yuan leads the Shen family from a humble farming household to rise step by step—eventually becoming a legendary immortal clan known across all realms!
associated_names: 从每日一卦开始打造长生仙族

118519.synopsis:
Meng Qingyin’s phone got infected with a virus.
But aside from being automatically added to some weird chat group, everything else seemed normal.
The group name? Something bizarre like “Road Survival Admin Chat.”
【Residents can enter the game with whatever they’re holding.】
Immediately, Meng Qingyin packed an outdoor survival kit!
【Why aren’t these residents paying closer attention to their surroundings?!】
Meng Qingyin scanned her environment—and sure enough, she spotted a newbie gift box hidden in the bushes!
【I’m going crazy—don’t they see the secret on the supply crate?!】
Meng Qingyin took a closer look at the crate… and yep, there it was: a hidden clue!
…
Starting with a wiggle car?
No panic—I can screen-peek the admin chat!
But her upgrade path seemed a little… off.
Why was her wiggle car evolving into a smart train?
Not only did it come with danger detection, it even had built-in turret cannons?!
associated_names: 公路求生：我被拉进了管理群

119543.synopsis:
Aoi Himura has a childhood friend named Kaori Nanami.
With looks that rival an idol, a flawless figure, top grades, athletic skill, perfect manners, a bright personality, and kindness to everyone—she’s the kind of popular girl everyone admires.
Aoi had always harbored a deep inferiority complex toward his brilliant and beloved childhood friend.
The only one who ever truly understood those feelings was Kaname Kirizuki—Kaori’s best friend.
While Kaori was surrounded by the elite crowd of their grade, handsome guys from the next class over, or the soccer club’s ace senior, Aoi and Kaname would quietly chat and laugh together in the corner of the classroom.
associated_names: 幼なじみは高嶺の花だが、ラブコメディーには手が届く

120823.synopsis: Three years ago, a man who had gone missing returned—bearing within him things that do not exist in this world.

124919.synopsis:
Chu Ling always thought she was just naturally bad at making friends.
Until one day, a system suddenly dropped into her life and told her she was actually a hated cannon fodder side character in a modern entertainment novel.
Chu Ling: Got it. I need to fix my public image.
System: Nope. You actually need to keep making people hate you to stay in character.
Chu Ling: Huh? Only an idiot would—
System: For every wave of negative emotions caused by you, we’ll deposit real money as a reward.
Chu Ling: —Thank you for the opportunity. I am that idiot. I’m all in.
Chu Ling joined a dating show and basically started swinging at everyone on screen. Her specialty? Not letting a single soul have peace.
A male guest with a “literary genius” persona gave her a heartfelt confession.
Chu Ling smiled sweetly: “Nice script. Shame the plagiarism check came back 90 percent. Better luck next time.”
Another rich-boy guest kept showing off in subtle ways.
Chu Ling rolled her eyes: “Bro, your fake watch is blinding me. Can you stop checking the time every ten seconds?”
A female guest gently asked her not to compete for the same guy since she already liked him.
Chu Ling gave her a pitying look: “Sweetheart, not everyone has taste as questionable as yours, alright?”
After racking up massive hatred across the internet, Chu Ling casually opened her account balance and sipped her tea: “Thank you, everyone. I humbly accept your criticism ^^”
But then, netizens slowly realized…
Her comebacks actually made sense.
She shut down toxic fans, exposed s*umbags, and snapped lovesick girls out of their delusions.
She wasn’t just stirring trouble — she was the mouthpiece of justice the internet didn’t know it needed.
A few episodes later…
Netizen A: Why hasn’t Chu Ling roasted anyone in so long?!
[You received ¥10,000.] 
Netizen B: I used to find her so annoying, but after the last two episodes, I kinda want to become a fan. Is this curable?
[You received ¥50,000.] 
Netizen C: Chu-jie! Without you, who’s gonna deal with all these tr*sh men?! Please come back!
[You received ¥100,000.] 
Chu Ling (dazed): …Wait, no one told me that missing someone, feeling conflicted, and pining for love also count as negative emotions?
A man who tossed and turned, unable to sleep at night due to a secret crush: Hmm… why doesn’t it count?
associated_names: Liàn zōng nǚ pèi, duì rén bào fù

126455.synopsis:
Ju Eunje was thirteen years old.
Her quiet life changed when her second sister’s friend, Yoon Kangheon, appeared.
“Who pushes someone from behind when they’re tying their shoelaces? You’re such a rude thug!”
“Your words are getting harsher.”
“Go be a gangster when you grow up!”
Every time, he would call her over, only to say he thought she was his friend.
Not only did he tease her annoyingly, but he would suddenly show up from somewhere, interfere in her business, and get in her way.
But strangely, as the years passed, he still teased and annoyed her the same way, yet there came a time when she somehow felt ticklish inside and couldn’t comfortably meet his eyes.
“Eunje, when you cry, your lips stick out this much. You look like a duck.”
“What do you mean, a duck? I’m not.”
“You’re cute.”
“Why are you calling me cute? It’s not like you’re trying to flirt with me.”
She wondered—was this feeling just like the tickling touch of peach fuzz that quickly passes, or was it like a peach she would end up eating even though she knew it would make her lips swell?
“If you don’t want to look cute, then just don’t cry from now on.”
Ju Eunje was sixteen years old.
Yes. That was when it began—when she thought she might actually like Kangheon.

127735.synopsis:
“That man is the Emperor. He’s on a level far beyond that of a lowly commoner like me. We could never be.”
At the celebration banquet held after slaying the evil dragon, the hero Crimson lays eyes on the beautiful emperor—and falls in love at first sight. Just as he steels himself to give up, crushed by the insurmountable barrier of status…
『“Ahh… ngh!”
“My, you’re trembling at the end. Are you enjoying this?”』
“If you don’t want this shameful video spread across the entire empire, you’d better do exactly as I say.”
A miracle occurs.
“Yes. I am blackmailing you.”
At the emperor’s whisper, Crimson lowers his head, eyes burning red as he squeezes them shut—longing to suck him dry until dawn, until he’s utterly emptied.
“His Majesty… he’s a pe*vert, but he’s kind.”
There’s no turning back now.
This hopeless one-sided love has already begun.

135671.synopsis:
Xiao Gui’an, a D-list actor, died—but not completely.
He was chosen to play an NPC in a supernatural horror world.
Now a ghost, Xiao Gui’an thought he could finally stop being afraid.
But who knew the protagonists in the horror world were even more terrifying than the ghosts themselves? They sliced through spirits like chopping vegetables, took the words “brutal” and “psychopath” to the extreme, and surviving in the hands of these destiny-favored madmen became priority number one.
So Xiao Gui’an had to do everything he could to juggle between ghosts and humans.
How did he rise through the ranks? With acting!
How did he keep his sanity value stable? Also with acting!
Eventually, thanks to his award-worthy performances, Xiao Gui’an unknowingly became a real boss respected by both humans and ghosts. The chosen ones started treating him like a walking cheat code, and he found himself stuck on the path of working three jobs a day like a tireless role model.
Xiao Gui’an: “Why the h*ll am I a ghost still fighting for my life every day?”
associated_names: I, Through Acting, Became the Horror Protagonists' Cheat Code
我，靠演戏成惊悚主角的金手指

156407.synopsis:
“Irix Berkhardt destroyed the world.
…This is the story of how he reduced it to ruins.”
Instead of passing on to the afterlife, I somehow woke up inside a novel—
the very novel written by one of my patients.
A world doomed to be destroyed by its future mastermind, Irix Berkhardt.
My immediate goal: stop Irix from ending the world.
But that’s easier said than done.
The body I’ve possessed never appeared in the parts I read,
so I have no idea about my abilities, identity, or even my past.
And Irix himself?
True to his destiny as the world’s destroyer, he’s fundamentally unhinged.
> “I know what you’re thinking, senior, so don’t worry in advance.”
> “Just stay right there and nothing will happen—
> no plates flying at you, no gunshots grazing your feet,
> and you won’t be thrown out the window either.”
As if that weren’t enough—
> “Please follow me! I’ll turn you into someone everyone will revere!”
People everywhere are scheming to push Irix further down the path of becoming the ultimate villain.
…Sigh.
How am I supposed to stop all of this?

159991.synopsis:
A beautiful woman born by God descended to a planet with a mission. Her mission is to devour fools.
The one who carries out God’s purpose is a lump of flesh that cannot resist God.
But even so, this lump of flesh continues to move, to satisfy its own instincts.
